name: EgoTempo
intro: EgoTempo是一个专门为评估多模态大模型在自我中心视频中时间理解能力而设计的数据集。它通过整合整个视频的信息来强调任务，确保模型需要依赖时间模式而非静态线索或预先存在的知识。实验表明，当前的多模态大模型在自我中心视频的时间推理方面仍有不足。
build_method: Ego4D片段提取, Gemini 1.5 Pro辅助问答生成, 人工复核, 单帧捷径过滤
modality: 视频, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 10类时序能力, 纯文本/单帧/多帧受控对照, LLM评委
scale: 500个问答对, 365个片段, 221段视频, 40个场景
build_method_en: Ego4D clip extraction, Gemini 1.5 Pro-assisted QA generation, manual review, single-frame shortcut filtering
eval_feature_en: 10 temporal capabilities, controlled text/single/multi-frame comparison, LLM judge
intro_en: EgoTempo is a dataset specifically designed to evaluate the temporal understanding ability of multimodal large models in egocentric videos. It emphasizes the task by integrating information from the entire video, ensuring models rely on temporal patterns rather than static cues or prior knowledge. Experiments show that current multimodal large models still have limitations in temporal reasoning for egocentric videos.

flowchart LR

drawio_review_note: Aligned with EgoTempo arXiv:2503.13646 Sections 3.1–4.3, Figures 2–5, and Tables 1 and 3. The diagram records Ego4D videos and timestamped narrations; narration-derived windows; grouping up to 120 narrations or 120 seconds; Gemini 1.5 Pro captioning and QA generation; all ten temporal/spatial capabilities; manual video-grounded review; removal of irrelevant, non-temporal, and single-frame-answerable pairs; the exact 500 QA / 365 clip / 221 video / 40 scenario scale; text-only, single-frame, and controlled multi-frame settings; MLLM prediction; Gemini 1.5 Pro binary judging against ground truth; per-capability accuracy; and the single-frame-to-video improvement ratio. MultiQA is deliberately excluded because the paper uses it only for the EgoSchema comparison, not EgoTempo scoring.
